title: Preservation Across Register Increment
statement: Let $A$ be a nondeterministic register machine with oracle, input $x$, and configuration guard $G$. Suppose the instruction at live state $l$ increments register $r$ and continues at state $l'$, and the configuration with state $l$, register valuation $v$, and no answer satisfies $G$. If the configuration with state $l'$, with register $r$ increased by one and all other registers unchanged, is terminating under $G$ and accepts exactly when proposition $P$ holds, then the original configuration has those same properties.
hypotheses_covered: The instruction at state l increments register r and continues at l'
The increment successor configuration is terminating under G and accepts exactly when P holds
